summary: Defines a new email header field, Archived-At, that gives a direct link to the archived copy of a particular message. It is useful for mailing lists that keep web archives, so recipients can link straight to the message. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Every letter gets a note on it saying where a copy is filed in the library. You can follow the note to find that exact letter again.

questions: how to link to an archived email message
